# Game Idea

**Title:** Solar Swerve

**Concept:** A top‑down endless runner on an HTML canvas where the player pilots a spaceship through an ever‑incoming field of asteroids. The ship can thrust left or right using arrow keys or mouse. Fuel cells appear occasionally; collecting them extends the play time.

**Lose Condition:** The game ends when the ship collides with an asteroid or runs out of fuel.
